infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Commute Ping uses foreground location during an active commute to show progress on this device. This build does not send location to contacts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Commute Ping reads motion sensors during an active commute to detect possible falls or phone snatches on this device. It never places calls automatically.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Commute Ping uses foreground location during an active commute to show progress on this device. This build does not send location to contacts.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Commute Ping to access your contacts so you can choose a trusted contact. Selected details stay on this device and no invitation is sent.

plugins.motionPermission: Commute Ping reads motion sensors during an active commute to detect possible falls or phone snatches on this device. It never places calls automatically.

plugins.cameraPermission: Commute Ping uses the camera only when you open SOS capture to record evidence on this device.
plugins.microphonePermission: Commute Ping uses the microphone only when you start SOS video recording.
